name: adc-approval
description: Aggregated approval-domain connector: zone onboarding (account whitelisting, bastion hosts, public whitelists, AK/SK, image publishing; 6 read + 3 write tools on the Liuyun platform, submission open, two-phase confirmation) plus Andon ticket forensics (enum maps, ticket list, single-ticket detail; 3 read tools and no ticket write tools). Connects as a remote HTTPS service behind a gateway.
